value.rationale: The complete classification covers a natural infinite family and the sharp width threshold: two free generators at n=3, torus geometry at n=4, and genuine cyclic order-3 fundamental/first-homology torsion at every n>=5, with a closed unbounded second-Betti formula. The explicit integral triple-sum presentation explains why the transition occurs and separates quotient torsion from torsion in the original complex. This is a motivated topological symmetry invariant, not a chosen numerical slice.
